description: Defines the SpdyStream class and related enums and interfaces for handling SPDY protocol streams within the Chromium networking code. Includes declarations for stream states, delegate interface, and methods for managing stream data, headers, flow control, and lifecycle.

classes.name: SpdyStream
classes.description: Represents a SPDY protocol stream, managing headers, data frames, flow control, and lifecycle events within a SPDY session.

classes.name: SpdyStream::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for protocol-specific behavior and event callbacks for a SPDY stream.

methods.name: SetDelegate
methods.description: Assigns a delegate to handle stream events.

methods.name: DetachDelegate
methods.description: Detaches and cancels the current delegate.

methods.name: OnFrameWriteComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a frame write.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data frames over the stream.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed.
